title.zh: 卷三十 本紀第三十: 天祚皇帝四 耶律淳 耶律雅里 耶律大石子:夷列 夷列妹:普速完 夷列次子:直魯古
title.en: Volume 30 Annals 30: Emperor Tianzuo 4 - Ye Luchun, Ye Luyali, Ye Ludashi and son: Yilie, Yi Lie and younger sister: Pu Suwan, Yi Lieci and son: Zhilugu
title.raw: 卷三十 本紀第三十: 天祚皇帝四 耶律淳 耶律雅里 耶律大石子:夷列 夷列妹:普速完 夷列次子:直魯古 Volume 30 Annals 30: Emperor Tianzuo 4 - Ye Luchun, Ye Luyali, Ye Ludashi and son: Yilie, Yi Lie and younger sister: Pu Suwan, Yi Lieci and son: Zhilugu

sentences.zh: 天祚皇帝四 耶律淳 耶律雅里 耶律大石子:夷列 夷列妹:普速完 夷列次子:直魯古

translations.literal: Emperor Tianzuo IV; Yelü Chun; Yelü Yali; Yelü Dashi: Yilie; Yilie's sister Pusuwan; Yilie's second son Zhilugu
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Tianzuo IV; Yelü Chun; Yelü Yali; Yelü Dashi — Yilie; Yilie's sister Pusuwan; Yilie's second son Zhilugu

sentences.zh: 天祚皇帝四

translations.literal: Emperor Tianzuo IV
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Tianzuo IV

sentences.zh: 五年春正月辛巳，項小斛祿遣人請臨其地。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on xinsi day, Xiang Xiaohulu sent men asking the emperor to visit his territory.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on xinsi day of the first spring month, Xiang Xiaohulu sent envoys asking the emperor to visit his territory.

sentences.zh: 戊子，趨天德，過沙漠，金兵忽至。

translations.literal: On wuzi day he hastened to Tiande; crossing the desert, Jin troops suddenly arrived.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day he hastened toward Tiande; crossing the desert, Jin troops suddenly appeared.

sentences.zh: 上徒步出走，近侍進珠帽，卻之，乘張仁貴馬得脫，至天德。

translations.literal: The emperor fled on foot; attendants offered a pearl cap; he refused it, mounted Zhang Rengui's horse and escaped, and reached Tiande.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor fled on foot; attendants offered a pearl cap, but he refused it, mounted Zhang Rengui's horse, and escaped to Tiande.

sentences.zh: [1]己丑，遇雪，無禦寒具，術者以貂裘帽進；

translations.literal: [1] On jichou day he met snow and had no cold-weather gear; diviners presented sable-fur caps;
translations.idiomatic: [1] On jichou day he met snow and had no cold-weather gear; diviners presented sable-fur caps;

sentences.zh: 途次絕糧，術者進吥與棗；

translations.literal: on the road food ran out; diviners presented bu and jujubes;
translations.idiomatic: on the road food ran out; diviners presented bu and jujubes;

sentences.zh: 欲憩，術者即跪坐，倚之假寐。

translations.literal: when he wished to rest, the diviners at once knelt and sat, leaning against them for a brief sleep.
translations.idiomatic: when he wished to rest, the diviners at once knelt and sat so he could lean on them for a brief sleep.

sentences.zh: 術者輩惟齧冰雪以濟饑。

translations.literal: The diviners could only gnaw ice and snow to stave off hunger.
translations.idiomatic: The diviners could only gnaw ice and snow to stave off hunger.

sentences.zh: 過天德。

translations.literal: He passed Tiande.
translations.idiomatic: He passed Tiande.

sentences.zh: 至夜，將宿民家，紿曰偵騎，其家知之，乃叩馬首，跪而大慟，潛宿其家。

translations.literal: At night, about to lodge in a commoner's house, he deceived them saying scouting horsemen; the household knew and thereupon knocked the horse's head, knelt and wept greatly, and he lodged secretly in their house.
translations.idiomatic: At night, about to lodge in a commoner's house, he deceived them by saying scouting horsemen were about; the household knew who he was, knocked the horse's head, knelt and wept greatly, and he lodged secretly in their home.

sentences.zh: 居數日，嘉其忠，遙授以節度使，遂趨項。

translations.literal: After several days he praised their loyalty and from afar invested them as military commissioner, then hastened to Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: After several days he praised their loyalty and from afar invested them as military commissioner, then hastened to Xiang.

sentences.zh: 以小斛祿為西南面招討使，總知軍事，仍賜其子及諸校爵賞有差。

translations.literal: He made Xiaohulu southwestern frontier commissioner for suppression, overall commander of military affairs, and still granted his son and various officers titles and rewards in differing degrees.
translations.idiomatic: He made Xiaohulu southwestern frontier commissioner for suppression and overall commander of military affairs, and still granted his son and various officers titles and rewards in differing degrees.

sentences.zh: 二月，至應州新城東六十里，為金人完顏婁室等所獲。

translations.literal: Second month, sixty li east of Ying Prefecture's new city, he was captured by Jin men Wanyan Lou Shi and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, sixty li east of Ying Prefecture's new city, he was captured by the Jin commander Wanyan Lou Shi and others.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯，至金。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on guimao day, he reached Jin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guimao day, he reached Jin territory.

sentences.zh: 丙午，降封海濱王。

translations.literal: On bingwu day he was demoted and enfeoffed Prince of the Sea Shore.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day he was demoted and enfeoffed as Prince of the Sea Shore.

sentences.zh: 以疾終，年五十有四，在位二十四年。

translations.literal: He died of illness, age fifty-four, on the throne twenty-four years.
translations.idiomatic: He died of illness at fifty-four, having reigned twenty-four years.

sentences.zh: 金皇統元年二月，改封豫王。

translations.literal: Jin Huangtong year 1, second month, he was changed to Prince of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Jin Huangtong year 1 he was changed to Prince of Yu.

sentences.zh: 五年，葬于廣甯府閭陽縣乾陵傍。

translations.literal: Year 5, buried beside Qian Mausoleum in Guangning Prefecture, Lüyang County.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 he was buried beside Qian Mausoleum in Lüyang County, Guangning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 耶律淳

translations.literal: Yelü Chun
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Chun

sentences.zh: 耶律淳者，世號為北遼。

translations.literal: Yelü Chun — his age is known as Northern Liao.
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Chun — his age is known as Northern Liao.

sentences.zh: 淳小字涅里，興宗第四孫，南京留守、宋魏王和魯斡之子。

translations.literal: Chun's childhood name was Nieli; he was Emperor Xingzong's fourth-generation grandson, son of Southern Capital regent and Song Prince of Wei Heluwo.
translations.idiomatic: Chun's childhood name was Nieli; he was Emperor Xingzong's fourth-generation grandson, son of Southern Capital regent and Song Prince of Wei Heluwo.

sentences.zh: 清甯初，太后鞠育之。

translations.literal: In early Qingning the Empress Dowager raised and nurtured him.
translations.idiomatic: In early Qingning the Empress Dowager raised and nurtured him.

sentences.zh: [2]既長，篤好文學。

translations.literal: [2] When grown he was devoted to literature.
translations.idiomatic: [2] When grown he was devoted to literature.

sentences.zh: 昭懷太子得罪，上欲以淳為嗣。

translations.literal: When the Memorializing Heir Apparent was condemned, the emperor wished to make Chun heir.
translations.idiomatic: When the Memorializing Heir Apparent was condemned, the emperor wished to make Chun heir.

sentences.zh: 上怒耶律白斯不，知與淳善，出淳為彰聖等軍節度使。

translations.literal: The emperor was angry at Yelü Baisi, knowing he was friendly with Chun, and sent Chun out as Zhangsheng and other armies military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was angry at Yelü Baisi, knowing he was friendly with Chun, and sent Chun out as Zhangsheng and other armies military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 天慶五年，東征，都監章奴濟鴨子河，與淳子阿撒等三百餘人亡歸，先遣敵里等以廢立之謀報淳，淳斬敵里首以獻，進封秦晉國王，拜都元帥，賜金券，免漢拜禮，不名。

translations.literal: Tianqing year 5, on the eastern campaign, superintendent Zhangnu crossed the Yazi River; with Chun's son Asa and more than three hundred others he fled back, first sending Dili and others to report Chun the plan to depose and enthrone; Chun beheaded Dili's head and presented it, was advanced Prince of Qin-Jin, appointed commander-in-chief, granted the gold warrant, exempted from Han bowing ritual, not called by name.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianqing year 5, on the eastern campaign, superintendent Zhangnu crossed the Yazi River; with Chun's son Asa and more than three hundred others he fled back, first sending Dili and others to report to Chun the plan to depose and enthrone; Chun beheaded Dili and presented his head, was advanced Prince of Qin-Jin, appointed commander-in-chief, granted the gold warrant, exempted from Han bowing ritual, and not called by name.

sentences.zh: 許自擇將士，乃募燕、雲精兵。

translations.literal: Permitted to choose his own officers and soldiers, he thereupon recruited elite troops of Yan and Yun.
translations.idiomatic: Permitted to choose his own officers and soldiers, he thereupon recruited elite troops of Yan and Yun.

sentences.zh: 東至錦州，隊長武朝彥作亂，劫淳。

translations.literal: Going east to Jinzhou, company chief Wu Chaoyan made disorder and seized Chun.
translations.idiomatic: Going east to Jinzhou, company chief Wu Chaoyan made disorder and seized Chun.

sentences.zh: 淳匿而免，收朝彥誅之。

translations.literal: Chun hid and escaped, gathered Chaoyan and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: Chun hid and escaped, gathered Chaoyan and executed him.

sentences.zh: 會金兵至，聚兵戰于阿里軫鬥，敗績，收亡卒數千人拒之。

translations.literal: When Jin troops arrived he gathered troops and fought at Ali Zhendou, was defeated, gathered scattered soldiers of several thousand and resisted them.
translations.idiomatic: When Jin troops arrived he gathered troops and fought at Ali Zhendou, was defeated, gathered several thousand scattered soldiers and resisted them.

sentences.zh: 淳入朝，釋其罪，詔南京刻石紀功。

translations.literal: Chun entered court; his crime was pardoned; an edict ordered Nanjing to carve stone recording his merit.
translations.idiomatic: Chun entered court; his crime was pardoned; an edict ordered Nanjing to carve stone recording his merit.

sentences.zh: 耶律雅里

translations.literal: Yelü Yali
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Yali

sentences.zh: 耶律雅里者，天祚皇帝第二子也，字撒鸞。

translations.literal: Yelü Yali was Emperor Tianzuo's second son; his style was Saluan.
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Yali was Emperor Tianzuo's second son; his style was Saluan.

sentences.zh: 七歲，欲立為皇太子，別置禁衛，封梁王。

translations.literal: At age seven he wished to establish him as heir apparent, separately set up inner guard, and enfeoffed him Prince of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: At age seven the court wished to establish him as heir apparent, separately set up inner guard, and enfeoffed him Prince of Liang.

sentences.zh: 保大三年，金師圍青塚寨，雅里在軍中。

translations.literal: Baoda year 3, Jin troops besieged Green Mound Stockade; Yali was in the army.
translations.idiomatic: In Baoda year 3 Jin troops besieged Green Mound Stockade; Yali was in the army.

sentences.zh: 太保特母哥挾之出走，間道行至陰山。

translations.literal: Grand Protector Temuge seized him and fled; by hidden route they reached Yin Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Protector Temuge seized him and fled; by a hidden route they reached Yin Mountain.

sentences.zh: 聞天祚失利趨雲內，雅里馳赴。

translations.literal: Hearing Tianzuo had met defeat and was hastening to Yunnei, Yali galloped to join him.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing Tianzuo had met defeat and was hastening to Yunnei, Yali galloped to join him.

sentences.zh: 時扈從者千餘人，多於天祚。

translations.literal: At the time those in attendance were more than a thousand, more than Tianzuo had.
translations.idiomatic: At the time those in attendance were more than a thousand — more than Tianzuo had.

sentences.zh: 天祚慮特母哥生變，欲誅之。

translations.literal: Tianzuo feared Temuge would cause trouble and wished to execute him.
translations.idiomatic: Tianzuo feared Temuge would cause trouble and wished to execute him.

sentences.zh: 責以不能全救諸王，將訊之。

translations.literal: He blamed him for being unable to fully save the princes and was about to interrogate him.
translations.idiomatic: He blamed him for being unable to fully save the princes and was about to interrogate him.

sentences.zh: 仗劍召雅里問曰：「特母哥教汝何為？

translations.literal: Drawing his sword he summoned Yali and asked, "What did Temuge teach you to do?
translations.idiomatic: Drawing his sword he summoned Yali and asked, "What did Temuge teach you to do?

sentences.zh: 」雅里對曰：「無他言。

translations.literal: " Yali replied, "Nothing else was said.
translations.idiomatic: " Yali replied, "Nothing else was said.

sentences.zh: 」乃釋之。

translations.literal: " He then released him.
translations.idiomatic: " He then released him.

sentences.zh: 天祚渡河奔夏，隊帥耶律敵列等劫雅里北走。

translations.literal: Tianzuo crossed the river fleeing to Xia; company commander Yelü Dilie and others seized Yali and fled north.
translations.idiomatic: Tianzuo crossed the river fleeing to Xia; company commander Yelü Dilie and others seized Yali and fled north.

sentences.zh: 至沙嶺，見蛇橫道而過，識者以為不祥。

translations.literal: Reaching Sha Ridge they saw a snake cross the road; those who knew omens deemed it inauspicious.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Sha Ridge they saw a snake cross the road; those who knew omens deemed it inauspicious.

sentences.zh: 後三日，群僚共立雅里為主。

translations.literal: Three days later the assembled officials together set up Yali as lord.
translations.idiomatic: Three days later the assembled officials together set up Yali as lord.

sentences.zh: 雅里遂即位，改元神曆，命士庶上便宜。

translations.literal: Yali thereupon took the throne, changed the era to Shenli, and ordered gentry and commoners to submit whatever was expedient.
translations.idiomatic: Yali thereupon took the throne, changed the era to Shenli, and ordered gentry and commoners to submit whatever was expedient.

sentences.zh: 雅里性寬大，惡誅殺。

translations.literal: Yali's nature was generous; he hated executions.
translations.idiomatic: Yali's nature was generous; he hated executions.

sentences.zh: 獲亡者，笞之而已。

translations.literal: Those captured who had fled were only flogged.
translations.idiomatic: Those captured who had fled were only flogged.

sentences.zh: 有自歸者，即官之。

translations.literal: Those who returned of themselves were at once given office.
translations.idiomatic: Those who returned of themselves were at once given office.

sentences.zh: 因謂左右曰：「欲附來歸；

translations.literal: He thereupon said to those at his side, "If you wish to attach, come and attach;
translations.idiomatic: He thereupon said to those at his side, "If you wish to attach, come and attach;

sentences.zh: 不附則去。

translations.literal: if you do not attach, then go.
translations.idiomatic: if you do not attach, then go.

sentences.zh: 何須威逼耶？

translations.literal: Why must there be coercion?"
translations.idiomatic: Why must there be coercion?"

sentences.zh: 」每取唐《貞觀政要》及林牙資忠所作治國詩，令侍從讀之。

translations.literal: Each time he took Tang's Zhenguan zhengyao and Linya Zizhong's poem on governing the state and ordered attendants to read them.
translations.idiomatic: Each time he took Tang's Zhenguan zhengyao and Linya Zizhong's poem on governing the state and ordered attendants to read them.

sentences.zh: 烏古部節度使糾哲、迭烈部統軍撻不也、都監突里不等各率其眾來附。

translations.literal: Ugu Route military commissioner Jiuzhe, Dilie Tribe commander-in-chief Tabuye, and superintendent Tulideng each led their masses to come and attach.
translations.idiomatic: Ugu Route military commissioner Jiuzhe, Dilie Tribe commander-in-chief Tabuye, and superintendent Tulideng each led their masses to come and attach.

sentences.zh: 自是諸部繼至。

translations.literal: From this time the various tribes came in succession.
translations.idiomatic: From this time the various tribes came in succession.

sentences.zh: 而雅里日漸荒怠，好擊鞠。

translations.literal: But Yali daily grew negligent and fond of cuju.
translations.idiomatic: But Yali daily grew negligent and fond of cuju.

sentences.zh: 特母哥切諫，乃不復出。

translations.literal: Temuge urgently remonstrated; he then no longer went out.
translations.idiomatic: Temuge urgently remonstrated; he then no longer went out.

sentences.zh: 以耶律敵列為樞密使，特母哥副之。

translations.literal: He made Yelü Dilie privy commissioner; Temuge was his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: He made Yelü Dilie privy commissioner; Temuge was his deputy.

sentences.zh: 敵列劾西北路招討使蕭糾里熒惑眾心，志有不臣，與其子麻涅並誅之。

translations.literal: Dilie impeached Northwestern Route commissioner for suppression Xiao Jiuli for deluding the masses, his intent not that of a subject, and together with his son Manei executed them.
translations.idiomatic: Dilie impeached Northwestern Route commissioner for suppression Xiao Jiuli for deluding the masses, his intent not that of a subject, and together with his son Manei executed them.

sentences.zh: 以遙設為招討使，與諸部戰，數敗，杖免官。

translations.literal: He made Yaoshe commissioner for suppression; fighting with the various tribes, several times defeated, was flogged and dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: He made Yaoshe commissioner for suppression; fighting with the various tribes, several times defeated, was flogged and dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 從行有疲困者，輒振給之。

translations.literal: Among those following, if any were weary, he would at once give relief.
translations.idiomatic: Among those following, if any were weary, he would at once give relief.

sentences.zh: 直長保德諫曰：「今國家空虛，賜賚若此，將何以相給耶？

translations.literal: Direct attendant Baode remonstrated, saying, "Now the state is empty; if bestowals are like this, how will we supply them?
translations.idiomatic: Direct attendant Baode remonstrated, saying, "Now the state is empty; if bestowals are like this, how will we supply them?

sentences.zh: 」雅里怒曰：「昔畋於福山，卿誣獵官，今復有此言。

translations.literal: " Yali angrily said, "Formerly when hunting at Fushan you slandered the hunt officer; now you again have this speech.
translations.idiomatic: " Yali angrily said, "Formerly when hunting at Fushan you slandered the hunt officer; now you again have this speech.

sentences.zh: 若無諸部，我將何取？

translations.literal: Without the various tribes, what would I take?
translations.idiomatic: Without the various tribes, what would I take?

sentences.zh: 」不納。

translations.literal: " He did not accept it.
translations.idiomatic: " He did not accept it.

sentences.zh: 初，令群牧運鹽濼倉粟，而民盜之，議籍以償。

translations.literal: Earlier he had ordered the herd offices to transport Salt Marsh granary grain, but the people stole it; discussion was to register them to compensate.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier he had ordered the herd offices to transport Salt Marsh granary grain, but the people stole it; discussion was to register them to compensate.

sentences.zh: 雅里乃自為直：每粟一車，償一羊；

translations.literal: Yali thereupon set the rate himself: for each cart of grain, one sheep;
translations.idiomatic: Yali thereupon set the rate himself: for each cart of grain, one sheep;

sentences.zh: 三車一牛；

translations.literal: three carts, one ox;
translations.idiomatic: three carts, one ox;

sentences.zh: 五車一馬；

translations.literal: five carts, one horse;
translations.idiomatic: five carts, one horse;

sentences.zh: 八車一駝。

translations.literal: eight carts, one camel.
translations.idiomatic: eight carts, one camel.

sentences.zh: 左右曰：「今一羊易粟二斗且不可得，乃償一車！

translations.literal: Those at his side said, "Now one sheep cannot even be exchanged for two dou of grain, yet you compensate one cart!
translations.idiomatic: Those at his side said, "Now one sheep cannot even be exchanged for two dou of grain, yet you compensate one cart!

sentences.zh: 」雅里曰：「民有則我有。

translations.literal: " Yali said, "If the people have, then I have.
translations.idiomatic: " Yali said, "If the people have, then I have.

sentences.zh: 若令盡償，民何堪？」

translations.literal: If you make them compensate in full, how can the people bear it?"
translations.idiomatic: If you make them compensate in full, how can the people bear it?"

sentences.zh: 後獵查剌山，一日而射黃羊四十，狼二十一，因致疾，卒，年三十。

translations.literal: Later hunting at Chala Mountain, in one day he shot forty yellow sheep and twenty-one wolves; he thereupon fell ill and died, age thirty.
translations.idiomatic: Later hunting at Chala Mountain, in one day he shot forty yellow sheep and twenty-one wolves; he thereupon fell ill and died at thirty.

sentences.zh: 耶律大石

translations.literal: Yelü Dashi
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Dashi

sentences.zh: 耶律大石者，世號為西遼。

translations.literal: Yelü Dashi — his age is known as Western Liao.
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Dashi — his age is known as Western Liao (Qara-Khitai).

sentences.zh: 大石字重德，太祖八代孫也。

translations.literal: Dashi's style was Chongde; he was the eighth-generation grandson of Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: Dashi's style was Chongde; he was the eighth-generation grandson of Taizu.

sentences.zh: 通遼、漢字，善騎射，登天慶五年進士第，擢翰林應奉，尋升承旨。

translations.literal: He mastered Khitan and Han script, was skilled at riding and archery, in Tianqing year 5 passed the jinshi examination, was selected Hanlin attendant-in-waiting, and soon was promoted Hanlin academician-director.
translations.idiomatic: He mastered Khitan and Han script, was skilled at riding and archery, in Tianqing year 5 passed the jinshi examination, was selected Hanlin attendant-in-waiting, and soon was promoted Hanlin academician-director.

sentences.zh: 遼以翰林為林牙，故稱大石林牙。

translations.literal: Liao took Hanlin as linya, so he was called Great Stone Linya.
translations.idiomatic: Liao took Hanlin as linya, so he was called Great Stone Linya.

sentences.zh: 歷泰、祥二州刺史，遼興軍節度使。

translations.literal: He served successively as Tai and Xiang two prefectures' prefect, and Liaoxing Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He served successively as Tai and Xiang two prefectures' prefect, and Liaoxing Army military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 保大二年，金兵日逼，天祚播越，與諸大臣立秦晉王淳為帝。

translations.literal: Baoda year 2, as Jin troops daily pressed, Tianzuo was driven from his capital; with the great ministers he set up King of Qin-Jin Chun as emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In Baoda year 2, as Jin troops daily pressed, Tianzuo was driven from his capital; with the great ministers he set up King of Qin-Jin Chun as emperor.

sentences.zh: 淳死，立其妻蕭德妃為太后，以守燕。

translations.literal: When Chun died he set up his wife Virtuous Consort Xiao as Empress Dowager to guard Yan.
translations.idiomatic: When Chun died he set up his wife Virtuous Consort Xiao as Empress Dowager to guard Yan.

sentences.zh: 及金兵至，蕭德妃歸天祚。

translations.literal: When Jin troops arrived Virtuous Consort Xiao returned to Tianzuo.
translations.idiomatic: When Jin troops arrived Virtuous Consort Xiao returned to Tianzuo.

sentences.zh: 天祚怒誅德妃而責大石曰：「我在，汝何敢立淳？

translations.literal: Tianzuo angrily executed Virtuous Consort Xiao and blamed Dashi, saying, "While I live, how dare you set up Chun?
translations.idiomatic: Tianzuo angrily executed Virtuous Consort Xiao and blamed Dashi, saying, "While I live, how dare you set up Chun?

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「陛下以全國之勢，不能一拒敵，棄國遠遁，使黎民塗炭。

translations.literal: " He replied, "Your Majesty with the power of the whole state could not repulse the enemy once, abandoned the state and fled far away, making the black-haired people suffer torment.
translations.idiomatic: " He replied, "Your Majesty with the power of the whole state could not repulse the enemy once, abandoned the state and fled far away, making the black-haired people suffer torment.

sentences.zh: 即立十淳，皆太祖子孫，豈不勝乞命於他人耶？

translations.literal: To set up the ten Chuns — all are Taizu's descendants — is surely better than begging life from others, is it not?
translations.idiomatic: To set up the ten Chuns — all are Taizu's descendants — is surely better than begging life from others, is it not?

sentences.zh: 」上無以答，賜酒食，赦其罪。

translations.literal: " The emperor had no reply; he granted wine and food and pardoned his crime.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor had no reply; he granted wine and food and pardoned his crime.

sentences.zh: 大石不自安，遂殺蕭乙薛、坡里括，自立為王，率鐵騎二百宵遁。

translations.literal: Dashi was ill at ease; he thereupon killed Xiao Yixue and Poliguo, styled himself king, and led two hundred iron cavalry fleeing by night.
translations.idiomatic: Dashi was ill at ease; he thereupon killed Xiao Yixue and Poliguo, styled himself king, and led two hundred iron cavalry fleeing by night.

sentences.zh: 北行三日，過黑水，見白達達詳穩床古兒。

translations.literal: Going north three days, crossing Black Water, he met Baidada xiangwen Chuangur.
translations.idiomatic: Going north three days, crossing Black Water, he met Baidada xiangwen Chuangur.

sentences.zh: 床古兒獻馬四百，駝二十，羊若干。

translations.literal: Chuangur presented four hundred horses, twenty camels, and sheep in number.
translations.idiomatic: Chuangur presented four hundred horses, twenty camels, and sheep in number.

sentences.zh: 西至可敦城，駐北庭都護府，會威武、崇德、會蕃、新、大林、紫河、駝等七州及大黃室韋、敵剌、王紀剌、茶赤剌、也喜、鼻古德、尼剌、達剌乖、達密里、密兒紀、合主、烏古里、阻卜、普速完、唐古、忽母思、奚的、糾而畢十八部王眾，[6]諭曰「我祖宗艱難創業，曆世九主，歷年二百。

translations.literal: Going west to Kedun city, he encamped at the Protectorate of the Pacified North, meeting the seven prefectures Weiwu, Chongde, Huifan, Xin, Dalin, Zihe, Tuo and the eighteen tribal kings of Great Yellow Shivewei, Dila, Wangjila, Chachila, Yexi, Bigude, Nila, Dalaguai, Damili, Mierji, Hezhu, Wuguli, Zubu, Pusuwan, Tanggu, Humusi, Xide, and Jiuerbi, [6] and addressed them, saying, "Our ancestors with hardship founded the enterprise; through the ages nine lords; through the years two hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Going west to Kedun city, he encamped at the Protectorate of the Pacified North, meeting the seven prefectures Weiwu, Chongde, Huifan, Xin, Dalin, Zihe, Tuo and the eighteen tribal kings of Great Yellow Shivewei, Dila, Wangjila, Chachila, Yexi, Bigude, Nila, Dalaguai, Damili, Mierji, Hezhu, Wuguli, Zubu, Pusuwan, Tanggu, Humusi, Xide, and Jiuerbi, [6] and addressed them, saying, "Our ancestors with hardship founded the enterprise; through the ages nine lords; through the years two hundred.

sentences.zh: 金以臣屬，逼我國家，殘我黎庶，屠翦我州邑，使我天祚皇帝蒙塵于外，日夜痛心疾首。

translations.literal: Jin as subject-state forced our state, ravaged our black-haired people, slaughtered and mowed our prefectures and counties, making our Emperor Tianzuo suffer dust abroad — day and night we are heartsick.
translations.idiomatic: Jin as subject-state forced our state, ravaged our black-haired people, slaughtered and mowed our prefectures and counties, making our Emperor Tianzuo suffer dust abroad — day and night we are heartsick.

sentences.zh: 我今仗義而西，欲借力諸蕃，翦我仇敵，復我疆宇。

translations.literal: I now take righteousness and go west, wishing to borrow the strength of the various fan, cut down our foe, and recover our territory.
translations.idiomatic: I now take righteousness and go west, wishing to borrow the strength of the various fan, cut down our foe, and recover our territory.

sentences.zh: 惟爾眾亦有軫我國家，憂我社稷，思共救君父，濟生民於難者乎？

translations.literal: Do only you masses also grieve for our state, worry for our altars, and think to together save the lord and father and rescue the black-haired people from hardship?"
translations.idiomatic: Do only you masses also grieve for our state, worry for our altars, and think to together save the lord and father and rescue the black-haired people from hardship?"

sentences.zh: 」遂得精兵萬餘，置官吏，立排甲，具器仗。

translations.literal: He thereupon obtained elite troops of more than ten thousand, set officials, established ranks, and prepared weapons.
translations.idiomatic: He thereupon obtained elite troops of more than ten thousand, set officials, established ranks, and prepared weapons.

sentences.zh: 明年二月甲午，以青牛白馬祭天地、祖宗，整旅而西。

translations.literal: Next year second month, on jiawu day, with green ox and white horse he sacrificed to Heaven, Earth, and ancestors, and arrayed the host westward.
translations.idiomatic: Next year second month, on jiawu day, with green ox and white horse he sacrificed to Heaven, Earth, and ancestors, and arrayed the host westward.

sentences.zh: 先遺書回鶻王畢勒哥曰：「昔我太祖皇帝北征，過卜古罕城，[7]即遣使至甘州，詔爾祖烏母主曰：『汝思故國耶，朕即為汝復之；

translations.literal: First he sent a letter to Uighur king Bilgege, saying, "Formerly our Taizu Emperor on the northern campaign passed Buguhan city, [7] and at once sent envoys to Ganzhou, proclaiming to your ancestor Wumu, saying, 'If you think of the old state, I shall restore it for you;
translations.idiomatic: First he sent a letter to Uighur king Bilgege, saying, "Formerly our Taizu Emperor on the northern campaign passed Buguhan city, [7] and at once sent envoys to Ganzhou, proclaiming to your ancestor Wumu, saying, 'If you think of the old state, I shall restore it for you;

sentences.zh: 汝不能返耶，朕則有之。

translations.literal: if you cannot return, then I shall possess it.
translations.idiomatic: if you cannot return, then I shall possess it.

sentences.zh: 在朕，猶在爾也。

translations.literal: With me, it is as with you.'
translations.idiomatic: With me, it is as with you.'

sentences.zh: 』爾祖即表謝，以為遷國於此，十有餘世，軍民皆安土重遷，不能復返矣。

translations.literal: Your ancestor thereupon memorialized thanks, thinking to move the state here; for more than ten generations army and people have all been attached to the soil and heavy to move, and could not return.
translations.idiomatic: Your ancestor thereupon memorialized thanks, thinking to move the state here; for more than ten generations army and people have all been attached to the soil and heavy to move, and could not return.

sentences.zh: 是與爾國非一日之好也。

translations.literal: Thus with your state it is not a single day's goodwill.
translations.idiomatic: Thus with your state it is not a single day's goodwill.

sentences.zh: 今我將西至大食，假道爾國，其勿致疑。

translations.literal: Now I shall go west to the Great Food; I borrow passage through your state — do not give rise to suspicion."
translations.idiomatic: Now I shall go west to the Great Food; I borrow passage through your state — do not give rise to suspicion."

sentences.zh: 」畢勒哥得書，即迎至邸，大宴三日。

translations.literal: Bilgege received the letter and at once welcomed him to the lodge and feasted him three days.
translations.idiomatic: Bilgege received the letter and at once welcomed him to the lodge and feasted him three days.

sentences.zh: 臨行，獻馬六百，駝百，羊三千，願質子孫為附庸，送至境外。

translations.literal: On departure he presented six hundred horses, one hundred camels, and three thousand sheep, wished to pledge sons and grandsons as vassals, and escorted him to the border.
translations.idiomatic: On departure he presented six hundred horses, one hundred camels, and three thousand sheep, wished to pledge sons and grandsons as vassals, and escorted him to the border.

sentences.zh: 所過，敵者勝之，降者安之。

translations.literal: Where he passed, those who opposed he overcame; those who submitted he pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Where he passed, those who opposed he overcame; those who submitted he pacified.

sentences.zh: 兵行萬里，歸者數國，獲駝、馬、牛、羊、財物，不可勝計。

translations.literal: The army marched ten thousand li; states that returned numbered several; camels, horses, cattle, sheep, and goods obtained could not be counted.
translations.idiomatic: The army marched ten thousand li; states that returned numbered several; camels, horses, cattle, sheep, and goods obtained could not be counted.

sentences.zh: 軍勢日盛，銳氣日倍。

translations.literal: Army power daily grew; keen spirit daily doubled.
translations.idiomatic: Army power daily grew; keen spirit daily doubled.

sentences.zh: 至尋思幹，西域諸國舉兵十萬，號忽兒珊，來拒戰。

translations.literal: Reaching Xunsi Gan, the various states of the Western Regions gathered troops of one hundred thousand, styled Qusun, and came to resist battle.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Xunsi Gan, the various states of the Western Regions gathered troops of one hundred thousand, styled Qusun, and came to resist battle.

sentences.zh: 兩軍相望二里許。

translations.literal: The two armies faced each other about two li.
translations.idiomatic: The two armies faced each other about two li.

sentences.zh: 諭將士曰：「彼軍雖多而無謀，攻之，則首尾不救，我師必勝。

translations.literal: He addressed the officers and soldiers, saying, "Though their army is many it is without plan; if we attack, head and tail will not rescue each other — our army is sure to win.
translations.idiomatic: He addressed the officers and soldiers, saying, "Though their army is many it is without plan; if we attack, head and tail will not rescue each other — our army is sure to win.

sentences.zh: 」遣六院司大王蕭斡里剌、招討副使耶律松山等將兵二千五百攻其右；

translations.literal: " He sent Six Courts Office great king Xiao Wolila, commissioner for suppression deputy Yelü Songshan, and others to lead two thousand five hundred troops attacking their right;
translations.idiomatic: " He sent Six Courts Office great king Xiao Wolila, commissioner for suppression deputy Yelü Songshan, and others to lead two thousand five hundred troops attacking their right;

sentences.zh: 樞密副使蕭剌阿不、[8]招討使耶律術薛等將兵二千五百攻其左；

translations.literal: privy deputy Xiao Chala Abu, [8] commissioner for suppression Yelü Shuxue, and others to lead two thousand five hundred troops attacking their left;
translations.idiomatic: privy deputy Xiao Chala Abu, [8] commissioner for suppression Yelü Shuxue, and others to lead two thousand five hundred troops attacking their left;

sentences.zh: 自以眾攻其中。

translations.literal: he himself with the mass attacked the center.
translations.idiomatic: he himself with the mass attacked the center.

sentences.zh: 三軍俱進，忽兒珊大敗，僵屍數十里。

translations.literal: The three armies all advanced; Qusun was greatly defeated; corpses lay for several tens of li.
translations.idiomatic: The three armies all advanced; Qusun was greatly defeated; corpses lay for several tens of li.

sentences.zh: 駐軍尋思幹凡九十日，回回國王來降，貢方物。

translations.literal: Encamped at Xunsi Gan altogether ninety days; the Huihui king came to submit and presented local products.
translations.idiomatic: Encamped at Xunsi Gan altogether ninety days; the Huihui king came to submit and presented local products.

sentences.zh: 又西至起兒漫，文武百官冊立大石為帝，以甲辰歲二月五日即位，年三十八，號葛兒罕。

translations.literal: Again going west to Qier Man, civil and military hundred officials invested Dashi as emperor; on jiachen year second month fifth day he took the throne, age thirty-eight, styled Gur Khan.
translations.idiomatic: Again going west to Qier Man, civil and military hundred officials invested Dashi as emperor; on jiachen year second month fifth day he took the throne, age thirty-eight, styled Gur Khan.

sentences.zh: 復上漢尊號曰天皇帝，改元延慶。

translations.literal: Again he took the Han honorific title Heavenly Emperor and changed the era to Yanqing.
translations.idiomatic: Again he took the Han honorific title Heavenly Emperor and changed the era to Yanqing.

sentences.zh: 追祖父為嗣元皇帝，祖母為宣義皇后，冊元妃蕭氏為昭德皇后。

translations.literal: He posthumously titled his grandfather Heir of the Source Emperor and his grandmother Virtuous Consort Empress; he invested primary consort Lady Xiao as Bright Virtue Empress.
translations.idiomatic: He posthumously titled his grandfather Heir of the Source Emperor and his grandmother Virtuous Consort Empress; he invested primary consort Lady Xiao as Bright Virtue Empress.

sentences.zh: 因謂百官曰：「朕與卿等行三萬里，跋涉沙漠，夙夜艱勤。

translations.literal: He thereupon said to the hundred officials, "I with you have marched thirty thousand li, toiled through desert, day and night in hardship.
translations.idiomatic: He thereupon said to the hundred officials, "I with you have marched thirty thousand li, toiled through desert, day and night in hardship.

sentences.zh: 賴祖宗之福，卿等之力，冒登大位。

translations.literal: Relying on the ancestors' blessing and your strength, we have rashly ascended the great position.
translations.idiomatic: Relying on the ancestors' blessing and your strength, we have rashly ascended the great position.

sentences.zh: 爾祖爾父宜加恤典，共用尊榮。

translations.literal: Your ancestors and fathers should receive added favor; together enjoy honor and glory.
translations.idiomatic: Your ancestors and fathers should receive added favor; together enjoy honor and glory.

sentences.zh: 」自蕭斡里剌等四十九人祖父，封爵有差。

translations.literal: " From Xiao Wolila and forty-nine others' grandfathers, titles were granted in differing degrees.
translations.idiomatic: " From Xiao Wolila and forty-nine others' grandfathers, titles were granted in differing degrees.

sentences.zh: 子 夷列

translations.literal: Son Yilie
translations.idiomatic: Son Yilie

sentences.zh: 子夷列年幼，遺命皇后權國。

translations.literal: Son Yilie was young; testamentary order had the empress hold state.
translations.idiomatic: Son Yilie was young; testamentary order had the empress hold state.

sentences.zh: 後名塔不煙，號感天皇后，稱制，改元咸清，在位七年。

translations.literal: Later name Tabuyan, title Gantian Empress; she held rule, changed the era to Xianqing, on the throne seven years.
translations.idiomatic: Later name Tabuyan, title Gantian Empress; she held rule, changed the era to Xianqing, on the throne seven years.

sentences.zh: 子夷列即位，改元紹興。

translations.literal: Son Yilie took the throne and changed the era to Shaoxing.
translations.idiomatic: Son Yilie took the throne and changed the era to Shaoxing.

sentences.zh: 籍民十八歲以上，得八萬四千五百戶。

translations.literal: Registering the people eighteen sui and above, he obtained eighty-four thousand five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Registering the people eighteen sui and above, he obtained eighty-four thousand five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 在位十三年歿，廟號仁宗。

translations.literal: On the throne thirteen years he died; temple name Renzong.
translations.idiomatic: On the throne thirteen years he died; temple name Renzong.

sentences.zh: 夷列妹 普速完

translations.literal: Yilie's sister Pusuwan
translations.idiomatic: Yilie's sister Pusuwan

sentences.zh: 子幼，遺詔以妹普速完權國，稱制，改元崇福，號承天太后。

translations.literal: The son was young; testamentary edict had younger sister Pusuwan hold state; she held rule, changed the era to Chongfu, title Chengtian Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: The son was young; testamentary edict had younger sister Pusuwan hold state; she held rule, changed the era to Chongfu, title Chengtian Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 後與駙馬蕭朵魯不弟朴古只沙里通，出駙馬為東平王，羅織殺之。

translations.literal: Later she had relations with the consort's younger brother Puguzhi Shali; she sent the consort out as Prince of Dongping and on false charges killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Later she had relations with the consort's younger brother Puguzhi Shali; she sent the consort out as Prince of Dongping and on false charges killed him.

sentences.zh: 駙馬父斡里剌以兵圍其宮，射殺普速完及朴古只沙里。

translations.literal: The consort's father Wolila led troops surrounding her palace and shot Pusuwan and Puguzhi Shali to death.
translations.idiomatic: The consort's father Wolila led troops surrounding her palace and shot Pusuwan and Puguzhi Shali to death.

sentences.zh: 普速完在位十四年。

translations.literal: Pusuwan was on the throne fourteen years.
translations.idiomatic: Pusuwan was on the throne fourteen years.

sentences.zh: 夷列次子 直魯古

translations.literal: Yilie's second son Zhilugu
translations.idiomatic: Yilie's second son Zhilugu

sentences.zh: 【評贊】

translations.literal: 【Commentary and Appraisal】
translations.idiomatic: 【Commentary and Appraisal】

sentences.zh: 耶律淳在天祚之世，歷王大國，受賜金券，贊拜不名。

translations.literal: Yelü Chun in Tianzuo's age twice ruled the great state, received the gold warrant, was praised in bowing and not called by name.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianzuo's reign Yelü Chun twice ruled the great state, received the gold warrant, and was honored with bowing while not called by name.

sentences.zh: 一時恩遇，無與為比。

translations.literal: For a time his favor had no equal.
translations.idiomatic: For a time no favor could compare with his.

sentences.zh: 當天祚播越，以都元帥留守南京，獨不可奮大義以激燕民及諸大臣，興勤王之師，東拒金而迎天祚乎？

translations.literal: When Tianzuo was driven from his capital, as commander-in-chief guarding Nanjing, could he alone not rouse great righteousness to stir the Yan people and the great ministers, raise troops loyal to the throne, resist Jin in the east and welcome Tianzuo?
translations.idiomatic: When Tianzuo was driven from his capital, could he not—as commander-in-chief at Nanjing—have roused great righteousness among the Yan people and great ministers, raised a loyal host to resist Jin in the east, and welcomed Tianzuo home?

sentences.zh: 乃自取之，是篡也。

translations.literal: Yet he took it for himself — that was usurpation.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he seized the throne for himself—that was usurpation.

sentences.zh: 況忍王天祚哉？

translations.literal: How much more did he bear Tianzuo!
translations.idiomatic: And how he wronged Tianzuo!

sentences.zh: 大石既帝淳而王天祚矣，復歸天祚。

translations.literal: Dashi had made Chun emperor yet still served Tianzuo; he returned to Tianzuo.
translations.idiomatic: Dashi had made Chun emperor, yet still served Tianzuo when he returned.

sentences.zh: 天祚責以大義，乃自立為王而去之。

translations.literal: Tianzuo blamed him with great righteousness; he thereupon styled himself king and left.
translations.idiomatic: Tianzuo rebuked him on grounds of righteousness; Dashi thereupon styled himself king and departed.

sentences.zh: 幸藉祖宗餘威遺智，建號萬里之外。

translations.literal: Fortunately relying on the ancestors' remaining might and lingering wisdom, he established a title ten thousand li away.
translations.idiomatic: By fortune of the ancestors' remaining might and lingering wisdom, he established a realm ten thousand li away.

sentences.zh: 雖寡母弱子，更繼迭承，幾九十年，亦可謂難矣。

translations.literal: Though a widowed mother and weak son succeeded one another in turn, for nearly ninety years — one may also call that difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Though a widowed mother and weak son handed on rule in turn for nearly ninety years, one may still call that an achievement hard-won.

sentences.zh: 然淳與雅里、大石之立，皆在天祚之世。

translations.literal: Yet Chun's, Yali's, and Dashi's establishments were all in Tianzuo's age.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the enthronements of Chun, Yali, and Dashi all fell within Tianzuo's lifetime.

sentences.zh: 有君而復君之，其可乎哉？

translations.literal: Having a lord yet making another lord — can that be permitted?
translations.idiomatic: To have a sovereign yet set up another—how can that be permitted?

sentences.zh: 諸葛武侯為獻帝發喪，而後立先主為帝者，不可同年語矣。

translations.literal: When Zhuge the Martial Marquis held mourning for Emperor Xian and afterward set up the Former Lord as emperor — that cannot be spoken of in the same year.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhuge the Martial Marquis mourned Emperor Xian and afterward enthroned the Former Lord—that is not a case to be named in the same breath.

sentences.zh: 故著以為戒雲。

translations.literal: Therefore it is set forth as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore this is recorded as a warning.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：遼起朔野，兵甲之盛，鼓行扙外，席捲河朔，樹晉植漢，何其壯歟？

translations.literal: Appraisal: Liao rose from the northern wilds; the flourishing of arms and armor — drums marched beyond the frontier, swept Hebei, planted Jin and set up Han — how magnificent!
translations.idiomatic: Appraisal: Liao rose from the northern wilds; arms and armor flourished—drums marched beyond the frontier, swept Hebei, planted Jin and raised Han—how magnificent!

sentences.zh: 太祖、太宗乘百戰之勢，輯新造之邦，英謀略，可謂遠矣。

translations.literal: Taizu and Taizong rode the momentum of a hundred battles, gathered a newly made state — heroic stratagem and design may be called far-reaching.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu and Taizong rode the momentum of a hundred battles and gathered a newly forged state; their heroic stratagem and design may be called far-sighted indeed.

sentences.zh: 雖以世宗中才，穆宗殘暴，連遘弑逆，而神器不搖。

translations.literal: Though Shizong was middling talent and Muzong cruel and violent, successive misfortunes of regicide and treason came — yet the sacred vessel did not shake.
translations.idiomatic: Though Shizong was middling in talent and Muzong cruel and violent, regicide and treason followed in succession—yet the sacred vessel did not tremble.

sentences.zh: 蓋由祖宗威令猶足以震疊其國人也。

translations.literal: Surely because the ancestors' awesomeness and orders still sufficed to shake and fold their own people.
translations.idiomatic: Surely because the ancestors' awesomeness and commands still sufficed to overawe their own people.

sentences.zh: 聖宗以來，內修政治，外拓疆宇。

translations.literal: From Shengzong onward they cultivated government within and extended territory without.
translations.idiomatic: From Shengzong onward they cultivated government within and extended territory without.

sentences.zh: 既而申固鄰好，四境安。

translations.literal: Thereafter they renewed solid neighborly goodwill; the four borders were secure.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter they renewed firm neighborly goodwill, and the four borders were secure.

sentences.zh: 維持二百餘年之基，有自來矣。

translations.literal: Maintaining a foundation of more than two hundred years had its reasons.
translations.idiomatic: That a foundation of more than two hundred years was maintained had its reasons.

sentences.zh: 降臻天祚，既丁末運，又觖人望，崇信奸回，自國本，群下離心。

translations.literal: Descending to Tianzuo, he both met the final fate and disappointed human expectation, trusted wicked flatterers, himself undermined the state's root — the masses below lost heart.
translations.idiomatic: Descending to Tianzuo, he met the dynasty's final fate and disappointed the people's hopes, trusted wicked flatterers, and himself undermined the state's root—those below lost heart.

sentences.zh: 金兵一集，內難先作，廢立之謀，叛亡之跡，相繼蜂起。

translations.literal: When Jin troops gathered, internal trouble arose first; plots to depose and enthrone, traces of rebellion and flight, followed one another like bees.
translations.idiomatic: When Jin troops gathered, internal trouble arose first; plots to depose and enthrone and trails of rebellion and flight swarmed like bees.

sentences.zh: 馴致土崩瓦解，不可復支，良可哀也！

translations.literal: Leading to earth collapsing and tiles disintegrating, beyond recovery — truly pitiable!
translations.idiomatic: The realm collapsed like earth and tiles beyond recovery—truly pitiable!

sentences.zh: 耶律與蕭，世為甥舅，義同休戚。

translations.literal: Yelü and Xiao for generations were nephew and uncle; righteousness was the same as shared weal and woe.
translations.idiomatic: Yelü and Xiao for generations were nephew and uncle; their bond was shared weal and woe.

sentences.zh: 奉先挾私滅公，首禍構難，一至於斯。

translations.literal: Fengxian took private interest and destroyed the public good, first caused disaster and raised difficulty, until it reached this.
translations.idiomatic: Fengxian put private interest above the public good, first stirred disaster and difficulty, until matters came to this pass.

sentences.zh: 天祚窮蹙，始悟奉先誤己，不幾晚乎！

translations.literal: Tianzuo in extremity at last understood Fengxian had misled him — was it not nearly too late?
translations.idiomatic: Tianzuo in extremity at last saw that Fengxian had misled him—was it not nearly too late?

sentences.zh: 淳、雅里所謂名不正，言不順，事不成者也。

translations.literal: Chun and Yali are what is called: the name not correct, speech not in accord, the affair not accomplished.
translations.idiomatic: Of Chun and Yali it is said: when the name is not correct, speech does not accord, and the affair is not accomplished.

sentences.zh: 大石苟延，彼善於此，亦幾何哉？

translations.literal: Dashi barely prolonged — he was better at this; yet how many years more?
translations.idiomatic: Dashi barely prolonged the line—better than the others, yet for how many years more?

sentences.zh: 校勘記

translations.literal: Collation Notes
translations.idiomatic: Collation Notes

sentences.zh: 至天德按金史八二蕭仲恭傳作「至霍里底泊」。

translations.literal: 1: "Reached Tiande" — According to Jin History 82 Xiao Zhonggong's biography reads "reached Huolidipo."
translations.idiomatic: 1: "Reached Tiande" — According to Jin History 82 Xiao Zhonggong's biography reads "reached Huolidipo."

sentences.zh: 清甯初太后鞠育之按淳死於保大二年，若「年六十」無誤，則當生於清寧九年，「清甯初」有誤字。

translations.literal: 2: "In early Qingning the Empress Dowager raised him" — Chun died in Baoda year 2; if "age sixty" is correct he would have been born in Qingning year 9; "early Qingning" has a textual error.
translations.idiomatic: 2: "In early Qingning the Empress Dowager raised him" — Chun died in Baoda year 2; if "age sixty" is correct he would have been born in Qingning year 9; "early Qingning" has a textual error.

sentences.zh: 天祚即位進王鄭按紀乾統元年六月，以北平郡王淳進封鄭王。

translations.literal: 3: "When Tianzuo took the throne, advanced Prince of Zheng" — According to the annals, in the sixth month of Qianyun year 1 Northern Ping Commandery King Chun was advanced Prince of Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: 3: "When Tianzuo took the throne, advanced Prince of Zheng" — According to the annals, in the sixth month of Qianyun year 1 Northern Ping Commandery King Chun was advanced Prince of Zheng.

sentences.zh: 乾統二年加越王按紀乾統三年十一月，鄭王淳進封越國王。

translations.literal: 4: "Qianyun year 2, advanced Prince of Yue" — According to the annals, in the eleventh month of Qianyun year 3 Prince of Zheng Chun was advanced King of Yue.
translations.idiomatic: 4: "Qianyun year 2, advanced Prince of Yue" — According to the annals, in the eleventh month of Qianyun year 3 Prince of Zheng Chun was advanced King of Yue.

sentences.zh: 宰相李純按紀保大二年三月及卷一○二本傳並作李處溫。

translations.literal: 5: Chancellor Li Chun — According to the annals Baoda year 2 third month and juan 102 his biography all read Li Chuwenn.
translations.idiomatic: 5: Chancellor Li Chun — According to the annals Baoda year 2 third month and juan 102 his biography all read Li Chuwenn.

sentences.zh: 大黃室韋等十八部按敵剌，百官志二作敵烈；

translations.literal: 6: Great Yellow Shivewei and eighteen tribes — Dila: Offices Annals 2 reads Dilie;
translations.idiomatic: 6: Great Yellow Shivewei and eighteen tribes — Dila: Offices Annals 2 reads Dilie;

sentences.zh: 王紀剌即金史之廣吉刺、元史之宏吉剌；

translations.literal: Wangjila is Jin History's Guangjici and Yuan History's Hongjila;
translations.idiomatic: Wangjila is Jin History's Guangjici and Yuan History's Hongjila;

sentences.zh: 茶赤剌，紀大安十年四月、百官志二並作茶劄剌，即元史之劄只剌特；

translations.literal: Chachila: annals Da'an year 10 fourth month and Offices Annals 2 both read Chazhala, which is Yuan History's Zhazhalaite;
translations.idiomatic: Chachila: annals Da'an year 10 fourth month and Offices Annals 2 both read Chazhala, which is Yuan History's Zhazhalaite;

sentences.zh: 鼻古特，百官志二作鼻國德；

translations.literal: Bigude: Offices Annals 2 reads Biguode;
translations.idiomatic: Bigude: Offices Annals 2 reads Biguode;

sentences.zh: 密兒紀，紀壽隆三年二月作梅里急，即元秘史之篾兒乞；

translations.literal: Mierji: annals Shoulong year 3 second month reads Meiliji, which is Yuan Secret History's Mierqi;
translations.idiomatic: Mierji: annals Shoulong year 3 second month reads Meiliji, which is Yuan Secret History's Mierqi;

sentences.zh: 忽母思，即百官志二之胡母思山部，兵衛志下之胡母思山蕃；

translations.literal: Humusi is Offices Annals 2's Humusi Mountain Tribe, Military Guard Annals lower's Humusi Mountain fan;
translations.idiomatic: Humusi is Offices Annals 2's Humusi Mountain Tribe, Military Guard Annals lower's Humusi Mountain fan;

sentences.zh: 糾而畢，部族表作紀而畢。

translations.literal: Jiuerbi: Tribal Relations table reads Jierbi.
translations.idiomatic: Jiuerbi: Tribal Relations table reads Jierbi.

sentences.zh: 卜古罕城羅校謂即太祖紀之古回鶻城。

translations.literal: 7: Buguhan city — Luo collation says it is the Old Uighur city in Taizu Annals.
translations.idiomatic: 7: Buguhan city — Luo collation says it is the Old Uighur city in Taizu Annals.

sentences.zh: 蕭剌阿不按下文作蕭查剌阿不。

translations.literal: 8: Xiao Chala Abu — Below reads Xiao Zhala Abu.
translations.idiomatic: 8: Xiao Chala Abu — Below reads Xiao Zhala Abu.
